description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Method_ConfigLoad class which provides methods for loading configuration files, assigning configuration variables, and managing scope within Smarty templates. It is part of the internal plugins of the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ConfigLoad
classes.description: Provides methods for loading configuration files, managing config variables, and handling scope within Smarty templates.

methods.name: configLoad
methods.description: Loads a configuration file, optionally loading only selected sections.

methods.name: _loadConfigFile
methods.description: Internal method to load and parse a configuration file, update template source, and compile the configuration.

methods.name: _loadConfigVars
methods.description: Loads configuration variables into the template, managing scope and merging variables appropriately.

methods.name: _assignConfigVars
methods.description: Assigns configuration variables to a given scope, merging with existing variables if necessary.

methods.name: _updateVarStack
methods.description: Updates the variable stack with new configuration variables for the template.

methods.name: _getConfigVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration variable, searching up the parent chain.
